label: US-CA-AB1609-2026 SECTION 1. / 22628.

obligations.text: (b)A large private business that violates this chapter shall be liable for a civil penalty not exceeding five thousand dollars ($5,000) for an initial violation, and ten thousand dollars ($10,000) for each subsequent violation.

(c)For purposes of this chapter, the use of commercially reasonable and practicable standards that are designed and intended to achieve compliance shall satisfy the “good faith effort” requirements of Section 22627.
